era.en: Doing everything you can to use it actively, the same as in the pre-AI era.
era.zh: 尽你所能去积极地使用它，这和人工智能出现之前是一样的。

era.en: The policies of the new Australian government reflected the attitudes of the era.
era.zh: 新澳大利亚政府的政策反映了那个时代的态度。

era.en: But the rise of cycling started in the industrial era, when bicycle manufacturing took off.
era.zh: 但骑行的兴起始于工业时代，当时自行车制造业腾飞。

era.en: This event marked the end of the Byzantine Empire and the beginning of a new era.
era.zh: 这一事件标志着拜占庭帝国的结束和一个新时代的开始。

era.en: But I think the current post-truth era is different for two reasons.
era.zh: 但我认为，当下的后真相时代由于两个原因而有所不同。

erosion.en: An erosion of trust happens when people gradually lose confidence in political and economic institutions.
erosion.zh: 当人们对政治和经济机构的信心逐渐丧失时，就会发生信任流失（erosion of trust）。

erosion.en: According to this idea, the island’s forests were destroyed to move the Moai, leading to soil erosion, food shortages, and eventually social breakdown.
erosion.zh: 根据这种观点，岛上的森林为了搬运 Moai 被砍伐殆尽，导致了水土流失、粮食短缺，最终引发了社会崩溃。

erosion.en: This is very dangerous for democracy. Bernardo thinks Portugal has seen an erosion of trust – a term for the gradual weakening of people's confidence in political and economic institutions, and the government in office.
erosion.zh: 这对于民主来说非常危险。Bernardo认为葡萄牙的信任度正在流失——这是一个用来形容人们对政治经济机构以及现任政府的信心逐渐减弱的术语。

error.en: Every knowledge creation system works through correcting errors, making guesses and correcting errors.
error.zh: 每一个知识创造系统都是通过纠正错误来运作的，做出猜测并纠正错误。

error.en: Every knowledge creation system works through correcting errors, making guesses and correcting errors.
error.zh: 每一个知识创造系统都是通过纠正错误来运作的，做出猜测并纠正错误。

error.en: Rather than trying to find perfect pilots, cockpits are now designed to account for human error.
error.zh: 与其试图找到完美的飞行员，现在的驾驶舱设计已经将人为错误考虑在内。

error.en: And then there were the accounting errors and “creative” savings calculations.
error.zh: 接着是会计错误和“富有创意”的节约计算方法。

error.en: What if there were errors? What if the data was misused?
error.zh: 如果出现错误怎么办？如果数据被滥用怎么办？

erect.en: He had temples erected to his own glory, with priests appointed to offer sacrifices to him as though he were Jupiter.
erect.zh: 他为自己的荣耀建造了神庙，并指定祭司向他献祭，仿佛他就是 Jupiter。

eradicate.en: And for a while, I thought this was a bad thing and I tried to eradicate Podcast Naval.
eradicate.zh: 有一段时间，我觉得这很糟糕，还试图根除“播客Naval”这个形象。

eradicate.en: And they didn’t just kill him; shortly after he was killed, so too were his wife and young daughter, in order to completely eradicate all lines of succession.
eradicate.zh: 而且他们不仅杀了他；在他死后不久，他的妻子和幼女也被杀害，以便彻底根除所有的继承血脉。

erupt.en: Protests erupted once again, but this time, they were directed at the new president.
erupt.zh: 抗议活动再次爆发，但这一次，它们的矛头指向了新总统。

erupt.en: The announcement was made by his vice president, and the crowds erupted in jubilation.
erupt.zh: 这一宣布由他的副总统发表，人群爆发出欢呼声。

erupt.en: Protests erupted across the country, with chants of “Elon Musk has to go” heard outside Tesla showrooms.
erupt.zh: 全美各地爆发了抗议活动，特斯拉展厅外听到了“Elon Musk 必须下台”的口号声。

erupt.en: But that same year, political tensions erupted in the tragic Tlatelolco massacre, when government forces killed student protestors.
erupt.zh: 但在同一年，政治紧张局势在悲惨的特拉特洛尔科大屠杀中爆发，当时政府军队杀害了学生抗议者。

erupt.en: In fact, sometimes tensions erupted. In 2011, detainees set fire to an accommodation block, and in 2014 hundreds of people went on hunger strike to protest their treatment.
erupt.zh: 事实上，冲突有时会爆发。2011 年，被扣留者放火烧了一栋宿舍楼，2014 年，数百人绝食抗议他们的待遇。

errand.en: So, it's a fool's errand on the surface.
errand.zh: 表面上看，这简直是件傻子才会做的事。
